caption: The drawing consists of a repeating geometric and botanical pattern, primarily in shades of green, red, and cream. There are four large, dark green leaf clusters, each radiating out symmetrically from a central point, and each leaf group is accented with smaller red oval shapes and green tear-drop forms near the center. These clusters are separated by cream-colored, oval and ellipse-shaped areas filled with fine, curved line work that resembles a quilted texture. Around the border, there are light green, stem-like shapes with small red buds or petals at their tips, running vertically and horizontally along the edges. The entire composition is bounded by a thin red border, framing the patterned section. The background and negative spaces are colored light cream, and are filled with fine curved lines creating a textured effect throughout the drawing.
title: Quilt
